LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerCourtQuestScript.questDescri: questDescription->A lotus pond design connected to Qinghe has surfaced. After accepting this quest, you will be able to build a lotus pond from the Misc category. If this is not a Qinghe start, Qinghe will arrive at the colony after the lotus pond is built. Then arrange the room containing the lotus pond into a decent Lotus Rain Pavilion. Once the pavilion settles, you will receive 1 lost score fragment that can be interpreted at an art bench.
